data.exact_reserve_text: Prior years of account  Prior year movements of GBP 5.8m in 2014, comprising GBP 5.4m adverse movements in claims reserving and GBP 40.4m movement in premiums, net of reinsurances  The prior year movements focus on the underwriting movements and no allocation of any investment income, foreign exchange gains or losses, or expense movements have been allocated to the prior years of account

prior_year_events.event_name: Sterling liability movements including one 2010 case forced to settlement by reinsurers
prior_year_events.impact_description: A 2010 case which was being defended was forced into settlement by reinsurers; gross movement on Sterling claims of GBP 1.8m, net of reinsurance settled at GBP 1.1m

prior_year_events.event_name: Movement on RITC brought forward from close of 2011 year of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Movement on the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) carried forward from the 2011 close contributed to adverse movements in 2014

prior_year_events.event_name: UK, Canadian and Irish liability awards (closed years movements)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Total movements across closed years: GBP 2.4m (Sterling), EUR 0.4m (Euro) and C$0.7m (Canadian dollar) primarily driven by liability awards

named_events.loss_description: Impacted a number of properties and also both the 2012 and 2013 years of account; subject to a reinsurance recovery

named_events.event_name: Part-cancellation of worldwide tours of high profile artistes
named_events.loss_description: A number of large contract bonus losses and part-cancellations led to reinsurance recoveries and significant impact on the contingency book
Series of larger claims on the travel binder caused poor loss ratios and ultimately the cessation of the binder in 2014

data.standardized_narrative: During 2014 the syndicate experienced adverse prior-year reserve movements, with narrative disclosure citing prior year movements of GBP 5.8m (principally adverse movements of GBP 5.4m in claims reserving). The deterioration was driven largely by liability awards in the UK and Canada (and to a lesser extent Ireland), a settlement on a 2010 case forced by reinsurers, and movements associated with a RITC carried forward from the 2011 close. This prior year strengthening represents a material increase relative to opening gross claims outstanding (approximately +20.7%).
raw_causal_phrases: Prior year movements of GBP 5.8m in 2014, comprising GBP 5.4m adverse movements in claims reserving and GBP 40.4m movement in premiums, net of reinsurances
the remaining movements in the closed years in calendar year 2014 have largely stemmed from UK and Canadian liability awards, and to a lesser extent, Irish liability awards.

Of the Sterling movement GBP 1.8m related to the 2010 year of account where one case which was being vigorously defended at the start of the year was forced in to a settlement by the reinsurers. Net of reinsurance recoveries, this claim settled at GBP 1.1m.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit standalone 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note with a clear gross claims movement was available in the provided pages. The prior_year_development_gbp_m is taken from narrative disclosures ('Prior year movements of GBP 5.8m' and 'GBP 5.4m adverse movements in claims reserving') and interpreted as a gross adverse movement. There is some ambiguity whether amounts quoted are gross or net of reinsurance for certain lines and some currency-denominated movements are reported in non-GBP currencies; amounts have not been converted. RITC effects are noted and may distort reserve movement comparability.
